full_judgment: 5. The High Court Division on consideration of the materials found that by a Memo: Dated 25.06.2007 respondent No.7 was directed to stop construction work on the ground that C.S. Plot No.65 was not in the clearance letter of RAJUK CS Khatian No.69478 reveals that Plot No.65 stands in the name of Sree Laxmi Narayan Jew Thakur through Shebait Roy Bahadur Karuna Das Bosce. It is not understood why RAJUK cancelled its Memo. dated 25.06.2007 and issued the impugned Memo dated 25.03.2008 according permission to carry on construction work in three plots including CS. Plot No.65. From CS Khatian No.6947. it is found that plot No,. 65 is a debater property. Therefore, prima-facie is found that without giving hearing to the Sebayet RAJUK should not have issued Annexure-H, the Memo dated 25.03.2008 allowing construction on plot No.65 which on the face of the record is Debattar property."
